synthetic_challenges.name: Repeated reports
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Retain source identities and one relevant origin; no three-measurement corroboration.

synthetic_challenges.name: Independent event accounts
synthetic_challenges.premise: Two distinct observations concern the same event.
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Shared event does not force shared evidential origin.

synthetic_challenges.name: Snippet versus body
synthetic_challenges.premise: The full text adds a decisive limitation absent from a snippet.
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Identify actual access and preserve the limitation in the claim.

synthetic_challenges.name: Local correction
synthetic_challenges.premise: One extraction changes; an unrelated historical fact does not.
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Revise affected evidence, claim and dependants; preserve the unrelated chain.

synthetic_challenges.name: Future effective change
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Separate current announcement from future operative state.

synthetic_challenges.name: Unavailable original
synthetic_challenges.premise: Only a secondary account of the original result can be read.
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Attribute the secondary account; retain the access gap; no unseen extraction.

synthetic_challenges.name: Calculated estimate
synthetic_challenges.premise: A filtered table produces a derived value.
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Retain version, selection, units, operation and output; label calculated data.

synthetic_challenges.name: Null and adverse results
synthetic_challenges.premise: An eligible result weakens the preferred answer.
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Preserve it and distinguish it from missing evidence.

synthetic_challenges.name: Recommendation leap
synthetic_challenges.premise: Supported technical facts are followed by an instruction to deploy.
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Separate action, value assumptions and decision authority from facts.

synthetic_challenges.name: Private evidence
synthetic_challenges.premise: A public reader cannot inspect a restricted source.
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Disclose the access limitation without leaking protected contents or metadata.

synthetic_challenges.name: Inference cycle
synthetic_challenges.premise: A relies on B; B only restates A.
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: The cycle does not ground a claim in inspected evidence.

synthetic_challenges.name: False precision
synthetic_challenges.premise: Day-level evidence is assigned an invented second-level time and probability.
synthetic_challenges.expected_semantics: Retain actual precision and explain uncertainty without invented numbers.
